text:
nidhi: FYI we saw a spike in tls handshakes failing around 09:03 UTC after the RBAC policy rollout. Affected: region-eu and region-apac frontends.

sam: Logs show `tls: no suitable certificate` on acceptor. I traced it to KMS decrypt DENIED for the per-region cert key.

ollie: Confirmed audit: `principal=svc-frontend action=kms.decrypt status=DENIED` at 09:02:47. RBAC merge removed a binding by accident.

nidhi: Mitigation path: add short-lived decrypt binding scoped to the key, with expiry condition, and open SEC-IR ticket. Any objections?

sam: +1. Also add a temporary geo-fallback cert in the proxy for regions while we fix RBAC, but prefer IAM change first to minimize restarts.

ops-bot: scheduled change window 09:10-09:15 UTC. Apply with audit note SEC-IR-2026-221.

ollie: Policy patch applied at 09:10:12, KMS decrypt successes at 09:10:45. Handshakes recovered.

nidhi: Postmortem items: 1) add CI check to simulate kms.decrypt for critical service accounts; 2) alert on kms.decrypt denied spikes; 3) document per-region cert key owners. I'll open SEC-PR-2026-221-PM.
